protocol_updates: closure is per lane-round, not per fleet: partial entries are the norm, closed_at required with any not-dispatched row
completion marker is not a report -> lane-round failed; marker naming real committed work -> ok + minimum-content defect
dispatch evidence = watchdog.log dispatch line (prompt file corroborates content; prompt without dispatch line = attempted dispatch = failed)
in-flight is debt: resolved by an appended closure-correction entry carrying supersedes; rounds array is append-only after closure (never in-place, never prepended)
lane_rounds map makes not-dispatched rows falsifiable; ok rows are falsifiable by the derivable report path
retroactive-closure type: presence-of-evidence only, never a pass record
stale-lane age computed from launch timestamp, not the tick counter (which resets on driver restart); progressing missions are flagged, not failed
